scope: Short P0→O250/H6→C3→K0 roadmap Round 3B; sequential C3 feature selection then conditional training-weight comparison. Research only; no canonical/live change.

contract.architecture: frozen P0 → O250/H6 → C3 normalized regret → K0
contract.opportunity: the original Round-3A C3 O stream is exactly shared across every C feature and C-weight arm
contract.paired_control: C41/uniform exactly reproduces all 16,029 Round-3A C3 candidate identities, conversion scores, and K0 expected-policy-net scores
contract.mda: 115-field C pool; valid true O-positive rows only; May–December 2024 chronological development window; labels resolved before each validation start; rank-C3 plus bounded top-20 conditional policy-net utility; >=60% positive fold stability
contract.selection_gate: 2025 and 2026 net EV/trade >=90 bps and participation >=70% of the preceding-stage control

decision.comparison_vs_C41: mean EV/trade +5.04 bps; total net +30,823 bps; mean CVaR10 +42.24 bps; worst month +44.77 bps; participation +8.23%
decision.reason: The 60-field target-specific stable prefix is the best two-era mean EV contract and improves the key downside metrics. All alternative weighting schemes reduce mean EV/trade, so uniform remains frozen for the next C-HPO stage.

supersession: The first refinement artifact ending _20260822_v1 is not used because its C feature arms used different C random seeds. It was retained immutably; v2 fixes the paired-control contract and is the only evidence referenced here.
caveat: 2025–2026 are sequential model-selection evidence, not an untouched promotion period.
